# Villa Venere - Amalfi Coast

Villa Venere is an entire private holiday villa at Via Lannio 8, Cetara, Italy, on the Amalfi Coast. It has three bedrooms, two bathrooms, six beds and accommodates up to 12 guests. Distinctive features include a panoramic sea-view terrace and private access to the sea with a dock, shower and loungers. Registration identifier (CIN): IT065041B49WWIMPWN.

## Concierge and experiences
- Martina is the host and personal guest contact before and during the stay.
- On request, Martina can help guests compare boat tours to Amalfi, Positano and Capri, private road itineraries, visits to Pompeii, Herculaneum, Vesuvius and Ravello, and private chefs at the villa.
- Experiences are arranged with selected independent local providers.
- Availability, operator, itinerary, price and conditions must be confirmed when the guest enquires.

## Verified property facts
- Whole villa for the guest's exclusive use
- Three bedrooms, two bathrooms, six beds, maximum 12 guests
- Equipped induction kitchen, living room with sea view, Wi-Fi, air conditioning and Smart TVs
- Panoramic private terrace and hot tub
- Private sea access; two kayaks, SUP boards and one pedal boat are available subject to conditions
- Approximately 50 m from nearby beaches, 84 m from the bus stop and 230 m from the ferry terminal
- No private on-site parking; guests may look for free public roadside spaces, use partner paid parking in Cetara, or request complimentary car collection at check-in and return at check-out when they will not use the vehicle during the stay
- Normal check-in from 15:00 and checkout by 11:00

- The public review feed currently aggregates 180 genuine guest reviews from Airbnb, Booking.com, Google and Vrbo, with an overall normalized rating of 5.0 out of 5.
